note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. All content is fictional and illustrative: a generic change-clause heading, generic procedure steps exactly as supplied, a fictional amendment label. Only the supplied steps are drawn (one station each); nothing is said about whether a change is valid or effective, and no outcome is shown. Brief customizable fields not exposed (coordinator decision BRIEF CUSTOMIZABLE FIELDS, SESSION_HANDOFF 2026-10-05): clauses as a list (one change clause is the motif's subject: clause), schedules, definitions, priorities (no ranking), actorLabels (no actors), actionProgress and finalState (the action always completes; the hold shows the supplied procedure travelled). objectLabels = proposal (the amendment sheet label).
